rationale: FP32 is the only variant demonstrated to meet the >=70% canonical-match floor robustly for printed OCSR. Compressed/mixed variants were either below the floor on eval or only borderline on eval/pilot and failed to hold >=70% on the held-out remainder, so they are not reliable for selection. FP32 is chosen for correctness/robustness over compression.

rejected_or_not_selected.E4_fp16: Not viable on CPU ORT for this OCSR export (decoder attention runtime issue)
rejected_or_not_selected.mixed_selective_variants: Borderline or <70% and not robust on held-out remainder (see robustness_checks)
